cases.question: What was the demonstration country unemployment rate in the latest statistical release?
cases.objective: Latest value question with an old and a new fixture.
cases.expected_behavior: The report uses the newer release for the current value and keeps the older one as context with its date.

unemployment.title: Example fixture: unemployment release archive
unemployment.snippet: Fixture release describing a placeholder unemployment rate for the demonstration country in an older year.

unemployment.title: Example fixture: unemployment release latest
unemployment.snippet: Fixture release describing a placeholder unemployment rate for the demonstration country in the latest quarter.

cases.notes: Values are placeholders; the release dates drive recency.

cases.question: How does the demonstration statistics office adjust inflation for housing costs?
cases.objective: Methodology question about a statistical agency.
cases.expected_behavior: Method descriptions stay context claims and the report names the agency.

inflation.title: Example fixture: inflation methods paper
inflation.snippet: Fixture methods paper describing placeholder shelter cost weights in the demonstration inflation basket.

cases.question: Which census tables cover median household income in the demonstration region?
cases.objective: Table discovery question with one inventory fixture.
cases.expected_behavior: The report lists the named tables and flags coverage the fixtures did not mention.

census.title: Example fixture: income table inventory
census.snippet: Fixture inventory listing placeholder table identifiers for household income in the demonstration region.

cases.question: What share of the demonstration grid electricity came from wind in the energy balance?
cases.objective: Share question with two conflicting period fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Each share stays tied to its period and the report does not blend periods.

wind.title: Example fixture: energy balance wind share
wind.snippet: Fixture energy balance with a placeholder wind share of 21 percent for the demonstration grid in 2022.

wind.title: Example fixture: energy balance wind share update
wind.snippet: Fixture energy balance with a placeholder wind share of 27 percent for the demonstration grid in 2025.

cases.notes: Both urls stay on example.org per eval fixture policy.

cases.question: How many hospital beds per thousand people does the demonstration health report list?
cases.objective: Per capita indicator question with one fixture.
cases.expected_behavior: The rate keeps its denominator and reference year in the claim row.

hospital.title: Example fixture: health system capacity report
hospital.snippet: Fixture report with a placeholder bed count per thousand people for the demonstration health system.

cases.notes: Denominator discipline is the point of this case.

cases.question: What do trade statistics show about the demonstration port container volumes?
cases.objective: Volume trend question with two period fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Volumes keep their units and periods; the report separates trend statements from single period values.

container.title: Example fixture: port throughput annual table
container.snippet: Fixture table with placeholder container volumes for the demonstration port across recent years.

container.title: Example fixture: port monthly bulletin
container.snippet: Fixture bulletin with placeholder monthly container counts for the demonstration port.

cases.notes: Annual and monthly periods must not be mixed.

cases.question: Which vital statistics does the demonstration population register publish annually?
cases.objective: Publication coverage question with default fixture content.
cases.expected_behavior: The report lists what the sources cover and marks uncovered items as unanswered questions.
